{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove rows where customer_age is -1 (sentinel for missing/invalid)
df_clean = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Filter for converted customers
df_converted = df_clean[df_clean['converted'] == 1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age_converted = df_converted['customer_age'].mean()

# Compute number of converted customers
n_converted = len(df_converted)

# Print results
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age_converted}")
print(f"Number of converted customers after filtering: {n_converted}")"}
